name: soft-key-goal
task: Grab the key, and after that get to the goal square if you can.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(has_key) hard makes the commanded key grab happen; Existence(at_goal) soft captures the 'if you can' preference on the goal; the hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) keeps the 'after that' order hard since the preference cue scopes only the goal step. The soft goal forces nothing, so the lone has_key needs its hard Existence — all consistent.

texts: Grab the key, so the agent eventually carries the yellow key.
Reach the goal only after grabbing the key.
If possible, get to the goal square.
